description: This file defines the ChannelsSidebarRight class, a UI component for the right sidebar in a chat application, with methods to interact with posts, close the sidebar, and verify content.

classes.name: ChannelsSidebarRight
classes.description: A class representing the right sidebar component in the chat UI, providing methods to interact with posts and sidebar controls.

methods.name: toBeVisible
methods.description: Checks if the sidebar container is visible.

methods.name: postMessage
methods.description: Posts a message in the sidebar.

methods.name: getPostById
methods.description: Retrieves a post by its ID.

methods.name: getLastPost
methods.description: Retrieves the last post in the sidebar.

methods.name: getFirstPost
methods.description: Retrieves the first post in the sidebar.

methods.name: toContainText
methods.description: Verifies the sidebar contains specific text.

methods.name: verifyCurrentVersionPostMessage
methods.description: Verifies the message content of the current version of a post.

methods.name: restorePreviousPostVersion
methods.description: Restores a previous version of a post.
